body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-31 15:55Z). Many "ready" P0 items in TermAl's backlog are already CODE-DELIVERED on master. They stay open only because acceptance evaluation is refused while turn-gated control is OFF (named_root_sighting_unavailable), or because a live proof is outstanding.
Example from 15:53Z: of the topics I dispatched, w-4fad42a4ffe7 (fixed by d998353c) and w-559787f77f80, w-72bb75ecd583, w-9b6940770927 and w-44909af1b8bc (fixed by cde926c4, 6365481c, 0fb7b034 and 5b10b2a3) all had landed fixes already.
Before dispatching a "ready" item:
1. Run `git log --oneline origin/master | grep <short-ref>` and read the item's latest notes.
2. Brief the worker to verify the remaining gap first, read-only, with a criterion map, before writing any code.
This backlog of code-done but unclosed items is a further reason to prioritise w-decd, which provides committed-input acceptance without a sighting, or restoring gated control.

Addendum, 15:58Z: `git log | grep <ref>` is NOT enough, because combined landings name only some refs. w-ee6648196897 was delivered in 16635a20 (full gate b9331c43) without its ref in the subject. Read the item's latest STATUS note (`show --notes`) for "delivered" or "DOSTARCZONO" before dispatching. A backlog triage of the ready P0s was assigned to Sol-edfd and is due in .evidence/backlog-triage-2026-10-31.md.
